faqs.question: What is Email to Bank Sync?
faqs.answer: Email to Bank Sync automatically brings bank statements received through email into Giddh, so you can process, map, and reconcile transactions without manually downloading and uploading statements.

faqs.question: Do I need to download bank statements manually?
faqs.answer: No. Once the bank email integration is configured, relevant statements can be synced into Giddh automatically.

faqs.question: What can I do after a statement is synced?
faqs.answer: You can review the statement, map transactions to the appropriate accounts, and reconcile them in Giddh.

faqs.question: Is Email to Bank Sync the same as direct bank integration?
faqs.answer: No. Email to Bank Sync is designed for bank statements received through email. It provides a simple way to bring those statements into Giddh for processing and reconciliation.
